title: Affine modulation preserves bentness
statement: Let $n$ be even and let $f:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb R$ be bent. For any sign $\sigma\in\{\pm1\}$ and any $a\in\mathbb F_2^n$, the function $x\mapsto\sigma\chi_a(x)f(x)$ is bent, where $\chi_a$ is the Walsh character indexed by $a$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a bent real-valued function on $\mathbb F_2^n$
